name: Standard Sales Order Processing - Happy Path
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid Sales Order payload satisfying route condition {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}}
expected_outcome: Message routed to CallActivity_102 (Message Mapping), CallActivity_13 (Interface Headers logged), terminates at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200 OK
validates: CallActivity_4 sets InputPayload property and configured headers; ExclusiveGateway_80 evaluates SequenceFlow_82 successfully; Message Mapping 1 executes; generic headers script completes without error

name: Sales Order Return Processing - Happy Path
expected_outcome: Message routed via SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71, logs headers to MPL, terminates at EndEvent_9
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 evaluates Return condition; bypasses Message Mapping 1; CallActivity_71 populates custom MPL header attributes (Country, Region, BusinessObject, Sender, TimeStamp)

name: Routing Condition Unmatched - Default Escalation End
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with order type not matching Route 1 or Route 2
expected_outcome: Message falls through to SequenceFlow_110 (Default) and triggers EscalationEndEvent EndEvent_11 with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path execution; escalation event triggered without throwing uncaught runtime exception

name: Message Mapping Runtime Failure - Error Subprocess Handling
trigger: Inbound SOAP message triggering Sales Order route but containing corrupted XML structure breaking Message Mapping 1
expected_outcome: Process terminates in SubProcess_91: CallActivity_97 restores original payload from ${property.InputPayload}, CallActivity_100 logs payload attachment, EndEvent_95 raises ErrorEndEvent
validates: Property 'InputPayload' capture in CallActivity_4; ErrorStartEvent_92 invocation; payload logging via Log_Payload.gsh attachment; final error state

name: Inbound SOAP Envelope Malformed - HTTP Sender Rejection
trigger: HTTP POST request with unparseable SOAP XML body
expected_outcome: HTTP 500 / SOAP Fault returned by SOAP adapter before business process execution
validates: Inbound SOAP adapter schema compliance and maximum body size boundary enforcement
